newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Three reported killed in Albania shootout.
newsitem.headline: Three reported killed in Albania shootout.

text.p: Three people were killed and at least 10 wounded on Friday in a shoot-out in the southern town of Vlore, where demonstrators and students have staged anti-government protests for three weeks, hospital officials said.

"The Shik (secret police) wanted to get the (student) hunger strikers out and they clashed with thousands of people who were there to protect the students," the official in Vlore told Reuters in Tirana by telephone.
"Three were shot dead and 10 are wounded, four or five of them are in serious condition," the hospital official said.

Around 42 students have been on hunger strike in the Adriatic port of Vlore for the past nine days in action that has acted as a beacon for student protests and other demonstrations across the Balkan state.

Details were still sketchy but the hospital official said the secret police clashed with thousands of Vlore residents. It was not immediately clear who started the shooting but one witness said the headquarters of the secret police in the town was set ablaze.

Albania has been hit by a wave of violent protests in the past two months after thousands of people learnt they had lost all their savings in fraudulent pyramid investment schemes. They blame the government for failing to alert them to the dangers of the savings funds.
